serv_state.summary: SERV bit-serial core state controller: a 5-bit cycle counter (3-bit binary o_cnt plus 4-bit one-hot cnt_lsb ring) and an init/run phase flag sequence instruction fetch, register-file requests, bus cycles, branches and traps.

blocks.name: phase_controller
blocks.description: Init/run phase flag, branch and trap decisions sequencing the two-stage instruction flow.

anchors.name: init_done
anchors.why: Two-phase state: first (init) stage done; selects init vs second stage for o_init, bus, rf writes.

anchors.name: o_init
anchors.why: Init-stage indication decoded from init_done and two-stage op.

anchors.name: trap_pending
anchors.why: Misalignment trap pending; blocks branch rf write and forces rf read.

anchors.name: take_branch
anchors.why: Branch-taken condition from ALU compare; latched into o_ctrl_jump.

anchors.name: last_init
anchors.why: Last cycle of init stage gating rf write and read requests.

anchors.name: gen_csr.misalign_trap_sync_r
anchors.why: Registered misalignment trap flag held until next fetch; drives o_ctrl_trap.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_jump
anchors.why: Branch decision latched at end of init, held through PC update stage.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_trap
anchors.why: Trap mode indication to control unit from ecall, irq or misalignment.

anchors.name: i_two_stage_op
anchors.why: Instruction class needing two stages; enables init stage.

anchors.name: i_branch_op
anchors.why: Branch/jump instruction class steering take_branch and rf write.

blocks.name: bit_counter
blocks.description: 0-31 bit-serial cycle counter with decoded position outputs.

anchors.name: o_cnt
anchors.why: Upper 3 bits of the 0-31 bit-serial cycle counter; decoded into cnt outputs and done.

anchors.name: gen_cnt_w_eq_1.cnt_lsb
anchors.why: 4-bit one-hot ring forming counter LSBs, started by i_rf_ready; nonzero gives o_cnt_en.

anchors.name: o_cnt_en
anchors.why: Counter-running enable; gates PC update, bufreg and bus cycle starts.

anchors.name: o_cnt_done
anchors.why: End-of-32-cycle indication; updates init_done, ibus_cyc and jump register.

anchors.name: o_cnt0to3
anchors.why: Representative decoded counter-position output (cnt0..cnt12 family).

anchors.name: o_mem_bytecnt
anchors.why: Byte count output taken from o_cnt upper bits for memory lanes.

blocks.name: bus_rf_requests
blocks.description: Instruction/data bus cycles, register-file and MDU request handshakes.

anchors.name: o_ibus_cyc
anchors.why: Instruction fetch request driven from ibus_cyc register.

anchors.name: i_ibus_ack
anchors.why: Instruction bus ack ending fetch and issuing rf read request.

anchors.name: o_dbus_cyc
anchors.why: Data bus cycle request after init for aligned memory ops.

anchors.name: i_dbus_ack
anchors.why: Data bus ack triggering register-file write request.

anchors.name: o_rf_rreq
anchors.why: Register-file read request on fetch ack or trap.

anchors.name: o_rf_wreq
anchors.why: Register-file write request when stage two can begin.

anchors.name: i_rf_ready
anchors.why: Register-file ready; shifted into cnt_lsb to start counting.

anchors.name: o_mdu_valid
anchors.why: MDU operation valid; disabled when MDU parameter is zero.

anchors.name: i_mdu_ready
anchors.why: MDU result ready triggering rf write request (MDU builds).

blocks.name: unit_enables
blocks.description: Enables for bufreg, PC update and rf read derived from counter and phase.

anchors.name: o_bufreg_en
anchors.why: Shift enable for buffer register during mem/branch/shift ops.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_pc_en
anchors.why: PC update enable during counting outside init.

serv_decode.summary: SERV instruction decoder: latches opcode/funct3/selected instruction bits on bus ack, then combinationally decodes them into control flags for state, ALU, memory, CSR, bufreg and immediate units.

blocks.name: Instruction field registers
blocks.description: Latch opcode, funct3 and selected bits when instruction arrives.

anchors.name: opcode
anchors.why: Latched 5-bit opcode held during execution; source of nearly all decode flags.

anchors.name: funct3
anchors.why: Latched funct3 field steering ALU, memory, CSR and branch decodes.

anchors.name: op20
anchors.why: Representative latched instruction bit (op20/21/22/26) for CSR and system decode.

anchors.name: imm30
anchors.why: Latched bit 30 selecting sub and signed shift.

anchors.name: i_wb_rdt
anchors.why: Instruction word from bus; fields latched into decode registers.

anchors.name: i_wb_en
anchors.why: Load enable latching instruction fields when fetch completes.

blocks.name: State/control decode
blocks.description: Instruction class flags for state machine and PC control.

anchors.name: o_two_stage_op
anchors.why: Flags two-stage instructions (mem, shift, branch, slt) to the state unit.

anchors.name: o_branch_op
anchors.why: Branch/jump instruction flag to state unit.

anchors.name: o_shift_op
anchors.why: Shift instruction flag to state and bufreg.

anchors.name: o_rd_op
anchors.why: Instruction writes rd.

anchors.name: o_dbus_en
anchors.why: Load/store instruction: enable data bus access.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_jal_or_jalr
anchors.why: Jump decode steering PC control unit.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_mret
anchors.why: mret decode to control/CSR.

anchors.name: o_e_op
anchors.why: ecall/ebreak exception instruction decode.

anchors.name: co_mdu_op
anchors.why: MDU instruction decode, disabled by MDU parameter by default.

blocks.name: ALU/memory decode
blocks.description: ALU operation and memory access decodes from funct3/opcode.

anchors.name: o_alu_rd_sel
anchors.why: One-hot ALU result select (add, slt, bool) from funct3.

anchors.name: o_alu_sub
anchors.why: ALU subtract for sub, branches, slt.

anchors.name: o_mem_cmd
anchors.why: Memory command: store vs load.

blocks.name: CSR decode
blocks.description: CSR address, enables and operation select.

anchors.name: csr_op
anchors.why: CSR access instruction decode feeding all CSR enables.

anchors.name: csr_valid
anchors.why: Distinguishes RF-stored CSRs from serv_csr-held ones.

anchors.name: o_csr_en
anchors.why: Enables access to RF-stored CSRs.

anchors.name: o_csr_source
anchors.why: CSR write/set/clear operation select from funct3.

blocks.name: Operand/immediate decode
blocks.description: Immediate format, bufreg and operand/writeback source decodes.

anchors.name: o_immdec_en
anchors.why: Per-field immediate decoder enables by instruction format.

anchors.name: o_immdec_ctrl
anchors.why: Immediate format control bits for immediate decoder.

anchors.name: o_bufreg_rs1_en
anchors.why: Bufreg adds rs1 (jalr, mem, shift).

anchors.name: o_op_b_source
anchors.why: Operand B source: rs2 vs immediate.

anchors.name: o_rd_alu_en
anchors.why: Selects ALU result for rd writeback.

serv_immdec.summary: SERV bit-serial immediate decoder: latches instruction fields from the bus into segment registers, then shifts them as a chained shift register to emit the immediate one bit per cycle, sharing the segments as rd/rs1/rs2 addresses.

blocks.name: immediate_shift_chain
blocks.description: Segment registers chained as shift register; emit serial immediate and rd/rs1/rs2 addresses.

anchors.name: gen_immdec_w_eq_1.imm19_12_20
anchors.why: Shift segment holding imm[19:12,20]; its upper bits drive o_rs1_addr and o_csr_imm.

anchors.name: gen_immdec_w_eq_1.imm30_25
anchors.why: Shift segment holding imm[30:25], feeding imm24_20 and imm11_7.

anchors.name: gen_immdec_w_eq_1.imm24_20
anchors.why: Shift segment holding imm[24:20]; drives o_rs2_addr and o_imm.

anchors.name: gen_immdec_w_eq_1.imm11_7
anchors.why: Shift segment holding imm[11:7]; drives o_rd_addr and o_imm.

anchors.name: gen_immdec_w_eq_1.imm7
anchors.why: Single-bit segment for instruction bit 7 used by B-type immediates.

anchors.name: gen_immdec_w_eq_1.imm31
anchors.why: Latched instruction bit 31 held as immediate sign for the whole operation.

anchors.name: gen_immdec_w_eq_1.signbit
anchors.why: Sign extension bit (imm31 masked for CSR) shifted into segments.

anchors.name: o_imm
anchors.why: Serial immediate output bit selected from segments or sign bit.

blocks.name: load_shift_control
blocks.description: Load, shift-enable and format-select controls for the segment chain.

anchors.name: i_wb_en
anchors.why: Load enable: parallel-loads all segment registers from i_wb_rdt.

anchors.name: i_cnt_en
anchors.why: Shift enable advancing the immediate shift chain each serial cycle.

anchors.name: i_immdec_en
anchors.why: Per-segment shift enables selecting which immediate segments shift.

anchors.name: i_ctrl
anchors.why: Selects sign bit vs neighbor segment inputs and o_imm source by format.

anchors.name: i_csr_imm_en
anchors.why: CSR immediate mode clearing the sign bit for zero extension.

ungrouped_anchors.name: i_wb_rdt
ungrouped_anchors.why: Instruction word bits loaded into the immediate segment registers.

serv_bufreg.summary: SERV buffer register: a bit-serial adder sums gated rs1 and immediate into a 32-bit shift register that provides the data-bus address, shifts and serial output.

blocks.name: Serial adder
blocks.description: Bit-serial add of gated rs1 and immediate with carry flip-flop.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: Serial adder sum of gated rs1, gated imm and carry, shifted into data.

anchors.name: c_r
anchors.why: Carry flip-flop of the serial adder held between bit cycles.

anchors.name: i_rs1_en
anchors.why: Gates rs1 operand into the serial adder.

anchors.name: i_imm_en
anchors.why: Gates immediate operand into the serial adder.

anchors.name: clr_lsb
anchors.why: Clears immediate LSB at cnt0 for jalr target alignment.

anchors.name: i_rs1
anchors.why: Serial rs1 operand input to the adder.

anchors.name: i_imm
anchors.why: Serial immediate operand input to the adder.

blocks.name: Buffer shift register
blocks.description: 32-bit shift register loaded from adder or shifted with sign fill.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: 32-bit shift register holding computed address/rs1; feeds o_q, o_dbus_adr, o_ext_rs1.

anchors.name: i_en
anchors.why: Shift enable for data register, carry update and o_q output gating.

anchors.name: i_init
anchors.why: Selects loading adder sum vs sign-fill shift into data register.

anchors.name: i_sh_signed
anchors.why: Selects arithmetic sign fill when shifting data register.

blocks.name: Outputs
blocks.description: Serial output, data bus address, address LSBs and extension rs1.

anchors.name: o_q
anchors.why: Serial output bit from data register gated by i_en.

anchors.name: o_dbus_adr
anchors.why: Word-aligned data bus address taken from data register.

anchors.name: o_lsb
anchors.why: Address low bits for byte-lane selection, zero for MDU ops.

anchors.name: o_ext_rs1
anchors.why: Full parallel data register exported to extension units.

serv_bufreg2.summary: Bit-serial RISC-V buffer register: a 32-bit dhi/dlo shift register that aligns store data, captures load data, and doubles as a shift-amount down-counter.

blocks.name: Data shift register
blocks.description: 32-bit dhi/dlo register: parallel load from bus, shifting for store alignment.

anchors.name: dhi
anchors.why: Upper 8 data bits; shift register in store mode, shift-amount down-counter in shift mode.

anchors.name: dlo
anchors.why: Lower 24 data bits shifted from dhi or loaded from bus data.

anchors.name: shift_en
anchors.why: Enables shifting dhi/dlo during init for store alignment or shift amount.

anchors.name: i_load
anchors.why: Parallel-loads bus data i_dat into dhi/dlo.

anchors.name: i_dat
anchors.why: 32-bit load data from bus latched into dhi/dlo.

anchors.name: o_dat
anchors.why: 32-bit store data {dhi,dlo} presented to the bus.

anchors.name: byte_valid
anchors.why: Store alignment condition (lsb + bytecnt < 4) gating shift_en.

blocks.name: Shift-amount counter
blocks.description: dhi low bits reused as down-counter signalling shift completion.

anchors.name: cnt_next
anchors.why: Decremented shift-amount count held in dhi low bits.

anchors.name: cnt_en
anchors.why: Enables down-counter mode of dhi during shift operations.

anchors.name: dat_shamt
anchors.why: Next dhi value: decremented shift count or shifted-in operand, chosen by cnt_en.

anchors.name: o_sh_done
anchors.why: Signals shift count wrapped: requested shifts performed.

anchors.name: i_shift_op
anchors.why: Selects shift-operation mode, changing shift_en and enabling counter mode.

blocks.name: Operand B / output mux
blocks.description: Selects rs2/imm operand and byte-lane serial output.

anchors.name: o_op_b
anchors.why: Operand B: rs2 or immediate, also shifted into dhi.

anchors.name: i_op_b_sel
anchors.why: Chooses rs2 versus immediate for operand B.

anchors.name: o_q
anchors.why: Serial output bit selected from o_dat by byte lane i_lsb.

anchors.name: i_lsb
anchors.why: Address low bits selecting byte lane for o_q and store alignment.

serv_ctrl.summary: SERV bit-serial PC controller: the PC is a 32-bit shift register; serial adders compute PC+4/2 and PC+offset with carry flops, and a mux selects trap, jump or sequential next PC.

blocks.name: PC register
blocks.description: Shift-register PC driving instruction bus, updated when pc_en.

anchors.name: o_ibus_adr
anchors.why: PC shift register driving instruction bus address; shifts in new_pc when enabled.

anchors.name: i_pc_en
anchors.why: Enables PC shift and carry register updates.

blocks.name: Sequential PC adder
blocks.description: Bit-serial PC+4/PC+2 adder with carry flop.

anchors.name: pc_plus_4
anchors.why: Serial sequential-PC adder result feeding new_pc and o_rd.

anchors.name: pc_plus_4_cy_r
anchors.why: Carry flop of bit-serial PC+4 adder held between bit cycles.

anchors.name: plus_4
anchors.why: Increment bits: 2 for compressed, 4 otherwise, injected at count bit.

blocks.name: Offset adder
blocks.description: Bit-serial PC-relative/immediate adder for jumps and AUIPC/LUI.

anchors.name: pc_plus_offset_aligned
anchors.why: Aligned PC+offset adder result: jump target, AUIPC result, bad PC.

anchors.name: pc_plus_offset_cy_r
anchors.why: Carry flop of bit-serial PC+offset adder.

anchors.name: offset_b
anchors.why: Offset adder operand: gated immediate for U-type else buffered offset.

anchors.name: i_utype
anchors.why: Selects immediate offset and U-type rd result.

blocks.name: Next-PC select
blocks.description: Chooses trap, jump or sequential PC; forms rd result.

anchors.name: new_pc
anchors.why: Next-PC mux result: trap vector, jump target or PC+4.

anchors.name: i_jump
anchors.why: Selects jump target versus PC+4 for new_pc.

anchors.name: i_trap
anchors.why: Selects CSR trap vector as next PC.

anchors.name: o_rd
anchors.why: Serial rd writeback data: PC+offset for U-type or PC+4 for JAL/JALR.

anchors.name: o_bad_pc
anchors.why: Misaligned jump target reported to CSR for mtval.

serv_alu.summary: Bit-serial RISC-V ALU: a serial adder with registered carry, sign-aware compare with registered result, and boolean unit, OR-muxed onto rd by one-hot select.

blocks.name: Serial adder
blocks.description: Bit-serial add/sub with carry register preset by i_sub.

anchors.name: result_add
anchors.why: Serial add/sub result bit from rs1 + op_b + carry; feeds rd mux and equality compare.

anchors.name: add_cy_r
anchors.why: Carry register held between serial bit cycles; preset to i_sub for subtraction.

anchors.name: i_sub
anchors.why: Selects subtraction: inverts op_b and presets carry-in.

anchors.name: i_rs1
anchors.why: Serial rs1 operand bit into adder, boolean unit and compare.

anchors.name: i_op_b
anchors.why: Serial operand B bit, inverted for subtraction.

blocks.name: Comparator
blocks.description: Eq/lt compare with registered result chained across bits; slt result.

anchors.name: o_cmp
anchors.why: Comparison result output (eq or lt) for branches; also latched into cmp_r.

anchors.name: cmp_r
anchors.why: Registered compare result carried across bits; used for eq chaining and slt.

anchors.name: result_lt
anchors.why: Signed/unsigned less-than computed from sign-extended operands and adder carry.

anchors.name: result_eq
anchors.why: Running equality: zero sum bit AND previous compare state.

anchors.name: i_cmp_eq
anchors.why: Selects equality vs less-than as compare output.

anchors.name: i_cmp_sig
anchors.why: Selects signed comparison by enabling operand sign extension.

anchors.name: result_slt
anchors.why: Set-less-than result: registered compare output on first bit, zeros elsewhere.

blocks.name: Boolean unit
blocks.description: Xor/or/and of rs1 and op_b selected by i_bool_op.

anchors.name: result_bool
anchors.why: Boolean xor/or/and result selected by i_bool_op, muxed onto rd.

anchors.name: i_bool_op
anchors.why: Selects xor/or/and/zero boolean operation.

blocks.name: Result mux
blocks.description: One-hot OR mux of ALU results and buffer bit onto rd.

anchors.name: o_rd
anchors.why: Serial rd result: OR of i_buf and selected ALU results.

anchors.name: i_rd_sel
anchors.why: One-hot select of add, slt or bool result onto rd.

anchors.name: i_buf
anchors.why: Shift/buffer register bit ORed directly into rd output.

anchors.name: i_en
anchors.why: Enables carry propagation and compare register update each serial cycle.

serv_mem_if.summary: SERV bit-serial memory interface helper that generates Wishbone byte selects, misalignment flag, and sign/zero-extends load data via a sticky sign-bit register.

blocks.name: Load data extension
blocks.description: Passes valid load bits to rd else sign/zero extension from signbit.

anchors.name: i_bufreg2_q
anchors.why: Serial load data from bufreg2; source of o_rd and sign bit.

anchors.name: o_rd
anchors.why: Serial rd write data: load bit or sign/zero extension.

anchors.name: dat_valid
anchors.why: Selects load data vs sign extension for o_rd; enables signbit capture.

anchors.name: signbit
anchors.why: Holds last valid data bit for sign extension of narrow loads.

anchors.name: i_bytecnt
anchors.why: External byte counter input deciding when data bits are valid.

anchors.name: i_signed
anchors.why: Selects sign vs zero extension of loaded data.

blocks.name: Byte select and alignment
blocks.description: Decodes address LSBs and size into wb_sel and misalignment flag.

anchors.name: o_wb_sel
anchors.why: Wishbone byte-lane select decoded from address LSBs and access size.

anchors.name: o_misalign
anchors.why: Reports misaligned word/half access from address LSBs.

anchors.name: i_lsb
anchors.why: Address low bits deciding byte lanes and misalignment.

anchors.name: i_word
anchors.why: Word-size access command affecting byte selects and data validity.

anchors.name: i_half
anchors.why: Halfword access command affecting byte selects and data validity.

serv_csr.summary: Bit-serial RISC-V machine-mode CSR unit: holds mstatus/mie/mcause bits in flops, computes write/set/clear CSR values serially, and edge-detects timer interrupts.

blocks.name: CSR registers
blocks.description: mstatus MIE/MPIE, mie MTIE and mcause flops with per-CSR enables.

anchors.name: mstatus_mie
anchors.why: Global interrupt enable mstatus.MIE; written by CSR access, cleared on trap, restored on mret.

anchors.name: mie_mtie
anchors.why: Timer interrupt enable bit written via mie CSR access; gates timer_irq.

anchors.name: mstatus_mpie
anchors.why: Saves mstatus_mie on trap entry for restore on mret.

anchors.name: mcause3_0
anchors.why: mcause exception code bits (bit31 twin mcause31 as member), set by trap logic or CSR write.

anchors.name: i_mstatus_en
anchors.why: mstatus CSR access enable: write MIE and drive mstatus onto csr_out.

anchors.name: i_mie_en
anchors.why: mie CSR write enable for mie_mtie.

anchors.name: i_mcause_en
anchors.why: mcause CSR access enable: write and read mcause.

blocks.name: CSR read/modify datapath
blocks.description: Builds csr_out from CSR sources and csr_in via write/set/clear.

anchors.name: csr_in
anchors.why: New CSR value: external write, set or clear of current csr_out by operand d.

anchors.name: o_q
anchors.why: Serial CSR read value (mstatus, mcause or regfile CSR) returned to rd.

anchors.name: i_csr_source
anchors.why: Selects CSR operation: keep, write, set or clear.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: CSR write operand: immediate or rs1 chosen by i_csr_d_sel.

anchors.name: i_rf_csr_out
anchors.why: CSR value stored in the register file, ORed into csr_out.

anchors.name: i_rs1
anchors.why: rs1 serial operand for CSR write/set/clear.

anchors.name: i_csr_imm
anchors.why: Immediate operand for CSRxI instructions.

blocks.name: Trap and interrupt control
blocks.description: Timer interrupt edge detect and trap/mret driven CSR updates.

anchors.name: o_new_irq
anchors.why: Rising-edge detected timer interrupt request to the core; also sets mcause.

anchors.name: timer_irq_r
anchors.why: Previous timer_irq value for rising-edge detection.

anchors.name: timer_irq
anchors.why: Pending timer interrupt: mtip gated by mstatus_mie and mie_mtie.

anchors.name: i_trap
anchors.why: Trap entry: clears MIE, saves MPIE, updates mcause.

anchors.name: i_mret
anchors.why: mret: restores mstatus_mie from mstatus_mpie.

serv_top.summary: SERV bit-serial RISC-V core top: a state/counter controller sequences decoder, immediate decoder, buffer registers, PC control, ALU, CSR and memory-interface units that process operands one bit per cycle over an external register file and Wishbone buses.

blocks.name: state_controller
blocks.description: serv_state cycle counter and phase control sequencing buses, RF requests and traps.

anchors.name: init
anchors.why: Init phase of two-stage instructions, steers bufreg and bufreg2.

anchors.name: cnt_en
anchors.why: Bit-serial cycle enable clocking ALU, immdec, CSR and RF interface.

anchors.name: cnt0
anchors.why: Decoded cycle-counter bit (representative of cnt* phase strobes).

anchors.name: cnt_done
anchors.why: End of 32-bit serial operation, ends bufreg/immdec/CSR sequences.

anchors.name: trap
anchors.why: Trap taken; redirects PC and writes mepc/mtval via RF interface.

anchors.name: jump
anchors.why: Branch/jump taken flag selecting PC+offset in ctrl.

anchors.name: mem_bytecnt
anchors.why: Byte counter for memory data alignment in bufreg2 and mem_if.

anchors.name: rd_en
anchors.why: Destination register write enable into RF interface.

anchors.name: o_rf_rreq
anchors.why: Register file read request from state controller.

anchors.name: o_rf_wreq
anchors.why: Register file write request from state controller.

anchors.name: i_rf_ready
anchors.why: Register file ready advancing state controller.

anchors.name: o_mdu_valid
anchors.why: MDU operation request from state controller.

anchors.name: i_ext_ready
anchors.why: Extension/MDU result ready; muxes ext result into load path.

blocks.name: instruction_decoder
blocks.description: Decoder turning latched instruction into unit control flags.

anchors.name: i_wb_rdt
anchors.why: Instruction word (optionally decompressed) feeding decode and immdec.

anchors.name: shift_op
anchors.why: Decoded shift instruction steering state, bufreg and bufreg2.

anchors.name: branch_op
anchors.why: Decoded branch/jump class to state controller.

anchors.name: dbus_en
anchors.why: Decoded load/store class enabling data bus sequencing.

anchors.name: alu_rd_sel
anchors.why: Selects ALU result source (add, bool, compare).

blocks.name: immediate_decoder
blocks.description: Immediate shift-out and register address extraction.

anchors.name: imm
anchors.why: Serial immediate stream to bufreg, bufreg2 and ctrl.

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Destination register index from immdec to RF interface.

anchors.name: rs1_addr
anchors.why: Source register 1 index to RF interface.

blocks.name: serial_datapath
blocks.description: Bufreg address adder, bufreg2 data shifter and bit-serial ALU.

anchors.name: bufreg_q
anchors.why: Buffer register serial output to ctrl, ALU and RF interface.

anchors.name: op_b
anchors.why: Second ALU operand (rs2 or imm) from bufreg2.

anchors.name: lsb
anchors.why: Address low bits for alignment and misalignment checks.

anchors.name: alu_rd
anchors.why: Serial ALU result written to rd via RF interface.

anchors.name: o_dbus_adr
anchors.why: Data bus address from buffer register.

anchors.name: o_dbus_dat
anchors.why: Store data from bufreg2 shift register.

blocks.name: pc_control
blocks.description: Serial PC update and instruction bus interface (optional aligner/decompressor).

anchors.name: o_ibus_adr
anchors.why: Instruction fetch address (PC) from ctrl unit.

anchors.name: o_ibus_cyc
anchors.why: Instruction bus cycle request from state controller.

anchors.name: i_ibus_rdt
anchors.why: Fetched instruction word feeding decoders.

anchors.name: i_ibus_ack
anchors.why: Instruction bus ack latching instruction into decoders.

anchors.name: ctrl_rd
anchors.why: PC-derived rd value (jal/auipc) from ctrl.

blocks.name: regfile_interface
